defect: The UntrustedData preset sets HashCollisionResistant = false instead of true, so data deserialized as untrusted uses the default equality comparer.
why: Collision-resistant hashing is what protects dictionary and map keys read from untrusted input against hash-flooding denial of service; the UntrustedData preset must keep it on.
